tokens.name: bg-void
tokens.usage: The deepest ground, behind everything. Used for the hero and for full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: The page ground. Blue-shifted rather than neutral black - pure #000 reads as an unstyled default, this reads as chosen.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: A card or panel sitting on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: A surface nested inside bg-surface, or a hover state.

tokens.name: bg-glass
tokens.usage: The translucent fill of a glass panel, over a backdrop blur. 4% white in dark; it must never be the only thing separating a panel from its ground.

tokens.name: edge-highlight
tokens.usage: The 1px inner highlight along the TOP edge of a glass panel. This single line is what reads as glass - without it a translucent panel looks like flat grey.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy. 17.4:1 on bg-canvas, 16.1:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and captions. 7.5:1 on bg-canvas dark, 6.3:1 light. Generous on purpose: on a dark ground, thin light text needs more headroom than the minimum.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, footnotes, inactive step labels. 5.7:1 dark, 4.9:1 light - still passes for body text, unlike most tertiary greys.

tokens.name: hue-source
tokens.usage: Stage 1, SOURCE: raw systems, un-profiled data. Amber because the stage is hot and unrefined. 9.4:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: hue-stage
tokens.usage: Stage 2, STAGE: the snapshot under your control. Violet. 5.5:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: hue-profile
tokens.usage: Stage 3, PROFILE: deduplication and the merge the business owns. Pink - the stage where problems surface. 5.5:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: hue-map
tokens.usage: Stage 4, MAP and TRANSFORM: rules, nothing else. Blue. 5.3:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: hue-verify
tokens.usage: Stage 5, VERIFY: preload validation and business sign-off. Cyan. 10.0:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: hue-load
tokens.usage: Stage 6, LOAD: reconciled and signed. Green, the only place green is allowed to mean done. 9.6:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand fill: primary buttons and selected states. White on it is 5.59:1. Deliberately deeper than accent-bright so it can carry white text.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: The brand as TEXT or an icon on a dark ground - links, eyebrows, the focus ring. 6.7:1 on bg-canvas. Never use accent for text: at 4.45:1 it fails.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline inside a panel. 8% white - not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The edge of an interactive control: input, select, unselected chip. 3.23:1 on bg-surface dark, 3.61:1 light - meets the 3:1 non-text minimum that separator cannot.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus-visible ring. 6.7:1 dark, 6.2:1 light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Ground behind an inline error.

tokens.name: glass-nav
tokens.usage: The floating nav ground, at 80%, paired with a saturate and blur backdrop filter.

tokens.name: glass-sheet
tokens.usage: The mobile nav sheet: 94% and FIXED dark, because the sheet drops over the hero media. A translucent sheet over a scroll-scrubbing canvas is unreadable at nav opacity.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The foot of a gradient over imagery, so text contrast comes from the scrim and not from the picture. Fixed dark in both themes - the picture underneath does not get lighter when the theme does.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: A FIXED-dark band: the hero, and any full-bleed section backed by media. Does not invert with the theme, because what sits on it (a photograph, a canvas sequence) does not invert either.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: A card on a fixed-dark band - a metric tile, the architecture panel.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: A node inside a card on a fixed-dark band, such as a box in the architecture diagram.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ink-900 / ink-800. Fixed light in both themes: 18.9:1 on ink-900. Using text-primary here would put dark text on a dark photograph in the light theme.

tokens.name: on-ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on a fixed-dark band. 7.8:1 on ink-900, 6.97:1 on ink-800, 6.4:1 on ink-700.

tokens.name: accent-on-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text or a fill on a fixed-dark band - the hero eyebrow, the scroll progress bar. Fixed light-violet in both themes: accent-bright inverts to a deep violet in light, which measures 3.03:1 on ink-900 and fails. 6.93:1 on ink-900, 6.19:1 on ink-800.

tokens.name: separator-on-ink
tokens.usage: Hairline on a fixed-dark band - badge borders, the legend rule, stat dividers. Fixed 12% white, because separator inverts to 8% black and disappears on a dark ground in the light theme.

tokens.name: glass-ink
tokens.usage: The floating nav ground. Fixed dark in both themes, because the nav sits over the hero media and carries on-ink text - glass-nav inverts, which would put light text on a light bar once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: glass-surface
tokens.usage: A glass CARD: the surface colour at 70% over a backdrop blur. bg-glass is 4% and only reads on a dark ground; this one works in both themes, which is what a card on the page canvas needs.

tokens.name: hue-source-on-ink
tokens.usage: Stage 1 on a fixed-dark band. Pinned to the dark value in both themes: the light variant measures around 3.5:1 on ink-900 and fails, because the band stays dark whatever the theme does. 9.78:1 on ink-900, 8.74:1 on ink-800.

tokens.name: hue-stage-on-ink
tokens.usage: Stage 2 on a fixed-dark band. Pinned to the dark value in both themes: the light variant measures around 3.5:1 on ink-900 and fails, because the band stays dark whatever the theme does. 5.71:1 on ink-900, 5.10:1 on ink-800.

tokens.name: hue-profile-on-ink
tokens.usage: Stage 3 on a fixed-dark band. Pinned to the dark value in both themes: the light variant measures around 3.5:1 on ink-900 and fails, because the band stays dark whatever the theme does. 5.71:1 on ink-900, 5.10:1 on ink-800.

tokens.name: hue-map-on-ink
tokens.usage: Stage 4 on a fixed-dark band. Pinned to the dark value in both themes: the light variant measures around 3.5:1 on ink-900 and fails, because the band stays dark whatever the theme does. 5.51:1 on ink-900, 4.93:1 on ink-800.

tokens.name: hue-verify-on-ink
tokens.usage: Stage 5 on a fixed-dark band. Pinned to the dark value in both themes: the light variant measures around 3.5:1 on ink-900 and fails, because the band stays dark whatever the theme does. 10.38:1 on ink-900, 9.27:1 on ink-800.

tokens.name: hue-load-on-ink
tokens.usage: Stage 6 on a fixed-dark band. Pinned to the dark value in both themes: the light variant measures around 3.5:1 on ink-900 and fails, because the band stays dark whatever the theme does. 9.95:1 on ink-900, 8.89:1 on ink-800.

families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter Display", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero line. Leading under 1 - at this size the lines must lock together.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Hero line on a phone, or a small section heading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Section intros and the hero subhead.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy. Leading is 1.6, looser than a light theme would need - light text on a dark ground blooms, and tight leading closes it up.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The stage label above a card title, always uppercase and always in that card's hue. Tracking is very wide - at 11px it is what makes the label read as a system marker rather than small text.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Stage numbers, counts, record figures. Monospace so columns of numbers align.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The big metric figure, always tabular.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Signal uses more air than a light theme would: on a dark ground, cramped panels turn into one grey mass.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, chip inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, small end.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Under a section heading.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding, narrow.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding, wide.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom.

radius.note: Radius scales with the element. Signal rounds a little harder than a neutral system - the softness is what keeps a dark, high-contrast page from feeling severe.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus corner, swatch, legend key.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chip, small tile, diagram node.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Input, select, slot.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panel, the pipeline frame.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Full-bleed feature panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the spectrum rule.

shadow.note: On a dark ground a black shadow does nothing. Depth comes from the edge highlight and from COLOURED glow - a shadow tinted with the element's own hue.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A glass panel: a deep cast shadow plus the inner top highlight. The inset line is the part that reads as glass.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A resting card.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Under a primary button. The button's own hue, thrown downward - this is the single most expensive-looking detail in the system, so spend it once per screen.

tokens.name: glow-hue
tokens.usage: A hue-coded card on hover, combined with a border-colour change to that card's hue.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The halo on a focused input, with the border changing to focus-ring.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Content container.

tokens.name: measure-panel
tokens.usage: A centred form panel.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for body copy.

tokens.name: measure-headline
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for a display heading.

tokens.name: z-aurora
tokens.usage: The blurred colour fields, behind all content.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: In-flow content, above the aurora.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: The floating nav.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Mobile nav sheet.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs.
